## Changes

- Preserve TorBox cache and seeder evidence when the player rebuilds source cards. This fixes the incorrect “TorBox Not Checked” label in the player source panel.
- Add always-on, bounded TorBox diagnostics for key visibility, enrichment, source-picker state and prefetch origin, without recording API keys, hashes, URLs or titles. Refresh the Integrations key indicator when the screen opens.
- Add encrypted QR-based phone entry for the TorBox API key through the existing companion page and relay. The key is not saved until Save is selected on the TV.
- Replace the source card's truncated metadata line with compact wrapping icon and text tags for provider, cache state, quality, HDR/DV, size, seeder provenance and languages.

## Verification And Limitations

Local Android unit tests, release lint, Android instrumentation-source compilation and signed 32-bit build passed. Phone companion UI and cryptography tests passed. Physical TV/Safari validation and live TorBox responses remain pending.
